verdict.rationale: The evidence documents event-triggered Workflows, such as auto-publishing to a status page 'when an incident is updated', and on-call rotation schedules. Neither is a recurring, time-based job or workflow scheduler. On-call schedules decide who is paged, which is an adjacent feature rather than scheduled automation, and a one-off event trigger is not a recurring schedule. No evidence shows cron-style or recurring workflow execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
